D: The misfit Delta fraternity takes on the dean of Faber College.
P: Serve the mains when Bluto yells food fight.
S: Bluto loading his tray in the cafeteria
Little bowls of mashed potato with gravy, jelly cubes and buttered dinner rolls, served on a cafeteria tray. Eat it, don't throw it.
Grapes frozen for 2 hours, piled on a big platter with olives, feta and pita, so everyone can eat like Romans.
the road trip to the roadhouse
Wings dried overnight, baked at 220C for 45 minutes until crisp, tossed in a barbecue and honey glaze.
M: cheap food for a broke fraternity
Beef mince browned with onion and capsicum, tomato sauce, Worcestershire, brown sugar and mustard, simmered 20 minutes until thick, piled onto toasted soft buns.
Franks simmered 5 minutes then griddled until blistered, in steamed buns with yellow mustard, onions cooked slowly in butter and warm sauerkraut with caraway.
W: the cafeteria, before it goes up
Vanilla cupcakes baked at 175C for 18 minutes, topped with buttercream in bright colours, safe to throw. Please don't.
K: Fruit punch of pineapple and orange juice, lemonade and vodka for the adults, in a big bowl with sliced fruit.

s.how: Freeze 500g grapes for 2 hours. Pile on a big platter with 200g olives, 200g feta drizzled with oil and 4 warm pita breads cut into wedges. Eat lying down like a Roman.

s.note: the road trip to the roadhouse
s.how: Dry 1kg chicken wings overnight and toss with garlic powder and salt. Bake at 220C for 45 minutes until crisp. Toss in 100ml barbecue sauce warmed with 2 tbsp honey.

m.note: cheap food for a broke fraternity
m.how: Brown 800g beef mince with an onion and a green capsicum. Add 200ml tomato sauce, 2 tbsp Worcestershire, 1 tbsp brown sugar and 1 tbsp mustard and simmer 20 minutes until thick. Pile onto 4 toasted soft buns.

w.note: the cafeteria, before it goes up
w.how: Beat 125g butter with 150g sugar, add 2 eggs and fold in 200g self-raising flour and 125ml milk. Bake 12 at 175C for 18 minutes. Beat 150g butter with 300g icing sugar, tint bright colours and swirl on.

d.how: Pour 500ml pineapple juice and 500ml orange juice into a big bowl with ice and sliced oranges. Top with 750ml lemonade. Add 150ml vodka for the adults' bowl only.
